result.summary: This is a residential street with a sidewalk on at least one side but lacking any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The roadway surface is in poor condition with visible cracking and patching, and there are no traffic control devices or lane markings present.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, which can create tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing or cause unpredictable vehicle movements.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate tripping hazards and improve overall safety for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at logical crossing points to provide pedestrians with a designated space and alert drivers to their presence.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility during dawn, dusk, and nighttime hours.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The roadway pavement is in poor condition with visible cracking and patching, and sightlines at the corner are partially obstructed by a large tree and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks, providing no visual guidance for pedestrians or warning to drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The road surface is heavily cracked and uneven, creating potential trip hazards for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree and parked vehicles near the corner may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines by moving pedestrians past parked cars before they cross.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.

result.summary: A residential street intersection lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. Parked vehicles near the corner significantly obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted crosswalks to designate a safe crossing path.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, including a large van, are positioned close to the corner, blocking visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the corner

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends at a vertical curb without a ramp, creating an accessibility barrier for those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to increase visibility and define the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the crossing points to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and clear signage. Overgrown vegetation at the corner creates significant sightline obstructions for both pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense, overgrown vegetation at the corner blocks sightlines between approaching vehicles and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Absence of marked crosswalks and curb ramps forces pedestrians to navigate the roadway without designated space or accessibility features.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: The existing sidewalk is cracked, uneven, and partially overgrown, creating tripping hazards and potentially forcing pedestrians into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the fence line

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a safe and accessible path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown bushes and trees at the corner to restore clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or other traffic control devices to manage vehicle flow and improve safety at the uncontrolled intersection.
